pages.title: Fluvisol
pages.text: Fluvisol is found along rivers in regions with wet and dry seasons. Its farmland is high quality: stored nutrients contribute 10% more to crop growth and yield, and applied fertilizer is 10% more effective.

pages.title: Mollisol
pages.text: Mollisol is found in cold grasslands with at least 250mm of rainfall. Its farmland is very high quality: stored nutrients contribute 20% more to crop growth and yield, and applied fertilizer is 20% more effective. This is the most fertile soil type.

pages.title: Podzol
pages.text: Podzol is found in conifer forests. Its farmland is poor quality: stored nutrients contribute 10% less to crop growth and yield, and applied fertilizer is 10% less effective.

pages.title: Oxisol
pages.text: Oxisol is found in wet tropical regions. Its farmland is very poor quality: stored nutrients contribute 20% less to crop growth and yield, and applied fertilizer is 20% less effective. This is the least fertile soil type.
